title: Slide public payload audit policy v1
purpose: Machine-readable policy for auditing public Slide documentation and release payloads. It defines public-theme restrictions, provider-selection boundaries, and sensitive-content checks; it does not authorize distribution or inspect private operator configuration.

evidence_requirements: audit the included .gitignore for the exact local-settings ignore entry
record local settings as excluded without reading or serializing their content
scan tracked content for populated bridge keys, bridge values, provider identities, and provider locations
treat ignore status as staging hygiene, not provider isolation evidence

audit_rules.message: Public payload text must not disclose private Theme identities, provider implementation details, bridge values, or local filesystem locations.
Public payload filenames and directories must not identify private Themes, providers, templates, or local roots.
Reference templates, fonts, and other binary assets require an explicit independent rights decision and allowlist entry before public distribution.
A public project may resolve only an explicitly allowlisted bundled Theme.
Public projects cannot use private Themes.
The audit must verify the included ignore rule, exclude local settings without reading them, scan tracked content for prohibited placement, and record the resulting evidence.

implementation_notes: Apply text matching only to UTF-8 text files; report undecodable files separately for binary-policy review.
Normalize path separators to forward slashes before matching relative paths.
Evaluate path patterns as embedded text as well as token-start matches; do not flag relative documentation paths or shell options as local roots.
Substitute approved deployment-specific denylist values outside the scanned public payload; do not store real private identifiers, roots, brands, or aliases in this policy.
Do not treat this policy as a substitute for private-asset extraction, rights review, or a release decision.
